mainEntity.name: What is AEO and why is it important for real estate brokers?

acceptedAnswer.text: AEO, or Answer Engine Optimization, focuses on making your digital content easily discoverable and understandable by AI-powered search engines and voice assistants. For real estate brokers, this means your property listings, agent profiles, and local market insights can appear directly in search results when potential clients ask questions. It's crucial because a significant portion of property searches now start with conversational queries, and AEO ensures your information is presented clearly and concisely, directly answering user needs and increasing visibility for your services.
acceptedAnswer.description: AEO helps real estate brokers appear directly in AI search results and voice assistant queries by optimizing content for conversational searches, increasing visibility for listings and services.
